plugins.faceIDPermission: Allow IUA Connect to use Face ID to unlock the app.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow IUA Connect to use the camera to read a code, and to take a picture you send in chat.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow IUA Connect to open the pictures and videos you choose to send.
plugins.cameraPermission: Allow IUA Connect to use the camera to take a picture you send in chat.
